steps.headline: Performance: fixed now?
steps.changed: "Prefer power saving" and its switch now sit alone on one line, lined up. The explanation and your detected graphics chips run full width underneath.

steps.headline: Backup & Sync: fixed now?
steps.changed: Every card now has its own label — "Main backup", "Additional backups", and "History" above the Sync log — so nothing reads as filed under the card above it. The second card's own line now says "Keep a second copy" (with its Optional tag), since the label already says "Additional backups".
steps.notice: "Keep a second copy" is the only new wording.

steps.headline: Buddy Floater: fixed now?
steps.changed: "Remove helper" is a full-width outlined button instead of bare text.
steps.notice: It only shows once the helper has been added (Linux).
